```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)





```

Importing data:
```{r}
library(readxl)
practice_cymate <- read_excel("practice_cymate.xlsx")
small_cymate <- read_excel("small_cymate.xlsx")
View(small_cymate)
View(practice_cymate)

```

Plotting: 
```{r}
df <- data.frame(practice_cymate)

melted <- melt(df, id=c("Position", "Context"))
melted

df_small <- data.frame(small_cymate)
melt_small <- melt(df_small, id=c("Position", "Context"))
melt_small
melt_small$variable <- factor(melt_small$variable, levels=c("perc_NM", "perc_M"))
melt_small
melt_small$color <- paste(melt_small$Context, melt_small$variable)
melt_small$color <- factor(melt_small$color, levels=c("CG perc_NM", "CG perc_M", "CHG perc_NM", "CHG perc_M", "CHH perc_NM", "CHH perc_M"))

melt_small


ggplot(melt_small, aes(fill=color, y=value, x=as.character(Position))) + 
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity", color="#565656") + 
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c(
    "#EEDDDC", "#C87988",
    "#dce9ec", "#6AA5AF", 
    "#E9EAD2", "#8A8F42"
  ))+ 
  xlab("Cytosines") + ylab("Percent methylation") + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) 


ggsave("sample_cymate_2.png", width=5, height=2.5)


```
